2026_04_NYJ_CHI.headline: The Jets’ late-game resilience meets a Chicago offense newly confident behind Case Keenum
2026_04_NYJ_CHI.paragraph1: New York fell to 1-2 in Detroit but rallied from a two-score deficit and produced two fourth-quarter touchdown drives, giving Aaron Glenn something tangible to build on. Chicago comes home after Case Keenum’s first start in nearly three years produced a decisive win over Philadelphia while Caleb Williams remains sidelined by a hamstring injury. The Jets need to prevent Chicago’s veteran quarterback from staying comfortable, while the Bears must contain New York’s late-game passing rhythm and avoid giving the Jets extra possessions.
2026_04_NYJ_CHI.model_rationale: Chicago’s quarterback situation changes the matchup’s texture, but Keenum’s poise and the Jets’ recent fourth-quarter response make pressure, turnover avoidance and late-down execution decisive.
